name: GitHub
description: Code hosting and DevOps platform with a very broad REST + GraphQL API covering repos, issues, PRs, actions, orgs and more.
access_notes: Free self-serve accounts; anyone can mint fine-grained or classic PATs from settings, register OAuth Apps, or create GitHub Apps (JWT + installation access tokens) without approval. GitHub recommends GitHub Apps for org/multi-tenant integrations.
mcp_notes: Official vendor MCP: github/github-mcp-server (remote hosted server with OAuth 2.1 or PAT auth, plus local Docker image). Composio GITHUB toolkit exists with 893 tools, OAuth2 auth, 20 triggers.
uncertainty_notes: primary_auth: GitHub actually steers third-party integrators to GitHub Apps (JWT -> installation tokens, user-authorization via OAuth code flow); listed OAuth authorization code as primary since that is the user-facing grant. basic_auth applies only to a few app-management endpoints (client_id/client_secret). Webhooks are a core documented feature (repo/org/app webhooks at docs.github.com/webhooks).

evidence.note: Tokens via PAT (fine-grained recommended), GitHub App, OAuth app, or Actions GITHUB_TOKEN; GitHub Apps recommended for org/behalf-of-user use; basic auth (client id/secret) for some app endpoints.
Official GitHub MCP server repo: remote server with OAuth login or GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN; local Docker image ghcr.io/github/github-mcp-server.
Remote GitHub MCP Server requires a valid access token (OAuth 2.1 recommended, PAT accepted) in the Authorization header.
Composio toolkit catalog lists GitHub: 893 tools, 20 triggers, OAUTH2 auth.
